definitions.gloss: to ooze out; to seep through
definitions.explanation: To slowly leak or flow out through a surface, as liquid gradually penetrates or emerges.

definitions.gloss: to show through; to come to the surface
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, for emotions or inner qualities to gradually become visible or apparent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{出|だ}す。
⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{出|だ}して⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Blood started to ooze from the wound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{染|し}み{出|だ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{染|し}みる→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧ (to soak in, to permeate) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to start, to begin to come out)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) - the liquid or quality comes out on its own

ASPECT (ている):
{染|し}み{出|だ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of seeping or oozing.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{溢|あふ}れ{出|だ}す→溢れ出す：06139_afuredasu⟧: to overflow
- ⟦{流|なが}れ{出|だ}す→流れ出す：06086_nagaredasu⟧: to flow out
- ⟦{滲|にじ}み{出|だ}す→滲み出す：29264_nijimidasu⟧: to ooze out (similar meaning)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{出|だ}す: blood oozes out
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{出|だ}す: water seeps out
- ⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{出|だ}す: oil seeps out
